note: Crafts of The Unmade/The Making (destruction_creation axis). RUINWORK is the destruction-pole craft of the Unmakers — who hold that ending a thing WELL is a craft, and that the world is choked with what should have ended; MAKECRAFT is the creation-pole craft of the Wrights of the New, who cannot stop making and whose cities are never finished, which is the point. Neither is villainous: an Unmaker's clearing is a mercy and a Wright's ceaselessness is a waste. Authored by Aevi, SNG-054.

abilities.name: Held Repair
abilities.narrationHints: The broken thing works again — for a while. You have not fixed it. You have persuaded it to keep going, and it knows, and it will stop.
abilities.description: Get a broken thing working again for about a day — a cracked axle, a split shaft, a torn bellows, a failed hinge. You have not fixed it; you have persuaded it to keep going, and it knows. The Wrights' field-craft.
abilities.notFor: Actually repairing anything (this is borrowed time and the borrowing is the point); anything alive; a thing broken past function — it must still be MOSTLY there; hiding that it is a stopgap.

tree.name: Thing Persuaded
tree.grants: A broken made thing functions again for about a day — a cracked axle, a split shaft, a torn bellows, a failed hinge. It carries what it carried before. ⚠ NAME THE HOUR IT WILL FAIL; the craft tells you and you must say it.
tree.cannot: It is NOT REPAIRED. When it goes, it goes without warning and usually worse than it broke the first time. It must still be mostly present — a shattered thing is not mostly there.

tree.name: Long Persuasion
tree.grants: Several things, or one thing for several days — a caravan's wheels across a season's bad road, a mill through the harvest.
tree.cannot: Every extension makes the eventual failure worse, and you are accumulating a list of things that will all fail near the same time.

tree.name: Kept Machine
tree.grants: Something large and badly broken kept in service — a mill, a lock-gate, a pump — while the real repair is impossible or unaffordable.
tree.cannot: ⚠ PEOPLE WILL STOP TREATING IT AS BROKEN. That is the danger: a kept machine becomes a working machine in everyone's mind except yours, and you are the only one who knows the hour.

abilities.name: Fault-Sense

abilities.notFor: Seeing what should be built (Maker's-Eye); mending.
